Internal: Get precomputed or fallback BUB entropy coefficients (R-only)

get_bub_precomputed.Rd

Internal: Get precomputed or fallback BUB entropy coefficients (R-only)

Usage

get_bub_precomputed(N, m, k_max)

Arguments

N

Integer. Total number of values.

m

Integer. Number of unique values.

k_max

Integer. Max number of basis terms.

Value

A numeric vector of coefficients from the BUB estimator.
